Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/markdown","uri":"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language_detection":{"detect_multiple":true,"enabled":true,"min_confidence":0.3}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].detected_languages);
}
```
